title: Lansdowne Bridge
subtitle: Victorian Engineering Wonder
description: Cross the historic 1889 cantilever bridge over the flowing Indus River. Enjoy sunset boat rides and illuminated night views from Lab-e-Mehran park.

title: Sadhu Bela Island
subtitle: Sacred Marble Temple
description: Accessible only by wooden boats, Sadhu Bela is an ornate marble sanctuary surrounded by the waters of the Indus River since 1823.

title: Royal Coach VIP
subtitle: First-Class Experience
description: Experience zero-gravity reclining leather seats, individual USB charging ports, climate control, and high-speed onboard WiFi.

title: Hotel One Sukkur
subtitle: Executive Stay & Dining
description: Military Road's finest executive hotel featuring 24/7 concierge, gourmet multi-cuisine dining, and soundproof luxury rooms.

title: Kot Diji Fort
subtitle: 18th-Century Fortress
description: Perched 110 feet on a limestone hill, Kot Diji's colossal bastions guard the date palm valleys with over 200 years of history.

title: River Palla Fish
subtitle: Indus Culinary Delight
description: Crisp fried spiced Indus Palla fish served fresh at Lab-e-Mehran riverfront with piping hot cardamom chai and naan.
